age.evidence: Controlled Cortical Impact (CCI) models were induced in male C57BL/6J mice (10 weeks old, 25–27 g) using a pneumatically controlled cortical impactor device (Precision Systems and Instrumentation LLC, TBI-0310), following a previously described protocol with slight modification.

disease_state.evidence: This study focuses on the hippocampal sub-regions, analyzing proteomic expression profiles in mice at the acute (1 day) and subacute (7 days) phases of post-TBI to understand subregion-specific vulnerabilities and long-term consequences.

material_type.evidence: Hippocampal subregions were extracted using Laser Microdissection (LMD); and subsequently analyzed by label-free quantitative proteomics.

sample_source.evidence: Three mice brains were collected from each group including Sham, 1-day post-TBI and 7-day post-TBI.

sex.evidence: C57BL/6J male mice were purchased from Jackson Lab (Stock No: 000664).

strain.evidence: C57BL/6J male mice were purchased from Jackson Lab (Stock No: 000664).
